reconstructed_theorem_text: For every finite type I with decidable equality, every measurable space Ω, every probability measure μ on Ω, and every function f : Ω → ℝ^{I×I}, if f is Bochner integrable with respect to μ and f(ω) is positive definite for μ-almost every ω, then the matrix-valued Bochner integral ∫_Ω f(ω) dμ(ω) is positive definite. Here positive definite means symmetric with xᵀAx > 0 for every nonzero x ∈ ℝ^I. The finite type I may be empty; in that case this nonzero-vector condition is vacuous. The index and outcome types may belong to independent type universes.
